note: Permit labels in this project are triage signals, not legal determinations. Verify the live DETE rules and actual SOC/duties before relying on a permit route.
important_hr_rule: Human resources administrative occupations (SOC 4138) are on the Ineligible Occupations List effective 13 May 2026.
csep_note: CSEP eligibility depends on the actual occupation, duties, qualifications, remuneration and a qualifying 2-year job offer; job title alone is not sufficient.
